items.source: true if the supplied path matched, false if it didn't
items.translation: true 如果提供的 path 匹配，否则为 false

items.source: pattern - the pattern to match against
items.translation: pattern - 要匹配的模式

items.source: path - the path to test
items.translation: path - 要测试的路径

items.source: Assumes that match(String, String) returns true for 'pattern' and 'path', but does not enforce this.
items.translation: 假定match(String, String)对'pattern'和'path'返回true，但并不强制执行此规则。

items.source: Performs caching based on setCachePatterns(boolean), delegating to tokenizePath(String) for the actual tokenization algorithm.
items.translation: 基于 `setCachePatterns(boolean)` 执行缓存，并将实际的标记化算法委托给 `tokenizePath(String)`。

items.source: If the return value is false, then the PathMatcher.match(String, String) method does not have to be used because direct equality comparisons on the static path Strings will lead to the same result.
items.translation: 如果返回值为 `false`，则不必使用 PathMatcher.match(String, String) 方法，因为对静态路径字符串进行直接相等性比较将得出相同的结果。

items.source: The full path given as parameter is used to test for exact matches. So when the given path is /hotels/2, the pattern /hotels/2 will be sorted before /hotels/1.
items.translation: 作为参数给出的完整路径用于测试精确匹配。因此，当给定的路径为 `/hotels/2` 时，模式 `/hotels/2` 将排在 `/hotels/1` 之前。

items.source: Default is true. Switch this to false for case-insensitive matching.
items.translation: 默认值为true。将其切换为false以启用不区分大小写的匹配。

items.source: The default implementation checks this AntPathMatcher's internal cache (see setCachePatterns(boolean)), creating a new AntPathStringMatcher instance if no cached copy is found.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查此 AntPathMatcher 的内部缓存（参见setCachePatterns(boolean)），如果未找到缓存副本，则创建一个新的 AntPathStringMatcher 实例。

items.source: This implementation simply concatenates the two patterns, unless the first pattern contains a file extension match (for example, *.html). In that case, the second pattern will be merged into the first. Otherwise, an IllegalArgumentException will be thrown.
items.translation: 此实现仅将两个模式连接起来，除非第一个模式包含文件扩展名匹配（例如 `*.html`）。在这种情况下，第二个模式将被合并到第一个模式中。否则，将抛出 `IllegalArgumentException`。

items.source: This Comparator will sort a list so that more specific patterns (without URI templates or wild cards) come before generic patterns. So given a list with the following patterns, the returned comparator will sort this list so that the order will be as indicated.
items.translation: 此 `Comparator` 将 排序列表，使更具体的模式（不带 URI 模板或通配符）排在通用模式之前。因此，给定包含以下模式的列表，返回的 comparator 将对此列表进行排序，顺序如下所示。

items.source: Part of this mapping code has been kindly borrowed from Apache Ant.
items.translation: 此映射代码的一部分已获 Apache Ant 慷慨借用。Apache Ant。

items.translation: 映射使用以下规则匹配 URL：

items.source: Note: a pattern and a path must both be absolute or must both be relative in order for the two to match. Therefore, it is recommended that users of this implementation to sanitize patterns in order to prefix them with "/" as it makes sense in the context in which they're used.
items.translation: 注意： 模式与路径必须同为绝对路径或同为相对路径才能匹配。因此，建议本实现的用户对模式进行清理，并在其前面添加"/"前缀，这符合它们的使用上下文。

items.source: Default is "/", as in Ant.
items.translation: 默认值为 "/"，与 Ant 相同。

items.source:
Default is for the cache to be on, but with the variant to automatically
turn it off when encountering too many patterns to cache at runtime
(the threshold is 65536), assuming that arbitrary permutations of patterns
are coming in, with little chance for encountering a recurring pattern.
items.translation: 默认情况下缓存处于开启状态，但会配置一个变体以在运行时遇到过多需要缓存的模式时自动将其关闭（阈值为 65536），前提是假设传入的模式为任意排列，且遇到重复模式的可能性极低。

items.source:
Determines whether the pattern at least matches as far as the given base
path goes, assuming that a full path may then match as well.
items.translation: 确定模式是否至少匹配到给定的基本路径，假设完整路径也可能随之匹配。

items.source:
When encountering too many patterns to cache at runtime (the threshold is 65536),
it turns the default cache off, assuming that arbitrary permutations of patterns
are coming in, with little chance for encountering a recurring pattern.
items.translation: 当运行时遇到的缓存模式过多（阈值为 65536）时，将默认缓存关闭，假设传入的是任意排列的模式，遇到重复模式的几率很小。

items.source: This method may be overridden to implement a custom cache strategy.
items.translation: 此方法可被重写以实施自定义缓存策略。

items.source:
For example: For pattern "/hotels/{hotel}" and path "/hotels/1", this method will
return a map containing "hotel" → "1".
items.translation: 例如：对于模式"/hotels/{hotel}"和路径"/hotels/1"，此方法将返回一个包含"hotel" → "1"的映射。
